route_outcome_classification.reason: The registered route_outcome_classification exists only for the 227 executed cells. All 61 reused cells lack it: the 58 retry5-origin cells have no route summary at all, and the 3 retry6-origin cells have only the route runner's own metrics summary, whose 'status' field is the density/intervention state and NOT the registered classification. Those 61 cells are recorded as UNAVAILABLE_NOT_INFERRED; the raw runner status is carried separately in route_runner_status_raw_not_a_classification and is never promoted to a classification.
